sources: Kit plan: docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0007_ikut.md (analysis 1, re-analysed in its "Kit (2026-10-20)" section). Hit structure, frames, keys, events, elements, stagger, finisher factors, SP and energy: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0007_ikut_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0007_ikut_* (game 1.6), as compiled by efsim kit-draft and corrected by hand where noted; values from SkillPatchTable (level 12: attack1–4 atk_scale 0.23 / 0.28 / 0.29 / 0.27, attack5 1.07 with poise 16 and atb 17, finisher 9, dive 1.8; battle skill atk_scale 1.01, atk_scale2 4.05, poise1 / poise2 5, atb 40, cost 100 SP; combo atk_scale 1.17, poise 5, atb 10, usp 5, cooldown 3 s; ultimate atk_scale1 3.5, atk_scale2 5.5, poise1 / poise2 10, cost 90, cooldown 15 s).

Skill descriptions (CharGrowthTable + I18nTextTable_EN). Battle skill "Tempestuous Arc": two slashes; "If the enemy has active Electrification, consume the Electrification to unleash an additional attack that deals Electric DMG and recovers some SP." Combo "Peal of Thunder": "COMBO TRIGGER: When an enemy suffers Electrification or after an enemy's Electrification is consumed." Ultimate "Exploding Blitz": a dash and an explosion that deal Electric DMG; "If the enemy has active Electric Infliction, consume the Electric Infliction and forcibly apply Electrification."

Talents and potentials: PotentialTalentEffectTable chr_0007_ikut_talent_1_1 / _1_2 (skillBbModifiers on chr_0007_ikut_normal_skill: talent_1 = 1, duration = 15, pulse_up += 0.0005 / 0.0008, count = 3); talent 2 (buff_chr_0007_ikut_talent_2: a chance to ignore an Arts Infliction applied on her; enemies don't inflict operators in the engine: no effect); P1 atb += 10 on the battle skill; P2 Agility and Intellect +15 (stat panel); P3 pulse_up × 1.3; P4 ultimate cost × 0.85; P5 count = 2 and buff_chr_0007_ikut_finish_count_p5 (clears the counter when it starts: nothing in a fresh fight). The engine applies talents' skillBbModifiers, then potentials (pulse_up 0.0008 × 1.3 at P5).

Not modelled: the dash attack (in no skill group; design.md), the dive attack in rotations (S10), hit-stops (Ti1b), InterruptAction, the ultimate's 3 s freeze of enemies with super armor below 10 (no super armor in EnemyData; bosses unaffected; as the Endministrator's seal), the frame-136 hits on `tar` (every enemy in range except the main target: none against one enemy), CheckDistanceCondition < 5 at frame 136 (assumed in range: she blinks to the target). Dead data left out: chr_0007_ikut_talent_1 (SkillData) and buff_chr_0007_ikut_talent_1, buff_chr_0007_ikut_atk_buff_talent_p5, buff_chr_0007_ikut_combo_skill_counts (no table attaches or creates them), the combo's tutorial marker.

Not verified against a log: no fixture has Arclight. Interims: the Wildland Trekker counter never expires (batch-3 B4, in-game test 65 (a)); the talent buff acts on the extra attack that completes the count (row 30, test 65 (b)); a combo trigger during the combo's own cooldown opens nothing (batch-3 T5, engine-wide, test 60).

stacks.label: Wildland Trekker: extra attacks counted
stacks.note: buff_chr_0007_ikut_normal_skill_extra_count (stackingType 3, maxStackCnt 3, lifeType 1), one layer per extra attack while talent_1 > 0 (normal_skill frame 136). Its duration is a literal 10 s, but lifeType 1: interim, the layers never expire (batch-3 B4, in-game test 65 (a)). At `count` layers (3; P5: 2) its buffEvent 6 handler grants the team buff and finishes all layers (buff wildland_trekker on the extra hit, triggers wildland_reset / wildland_reset_p5).

buffs.label: Wildland Trekker (talent 1): team Electric DMG per point of Intellect
buffs.note: extra_count buffEvent 6: CheckBuffStackNumAdvanced ≥ count → StoreAttributeValue attribute 41 (her Intellect) × pulse_up → final_pulse_up → CreateBuff buff_chr_0007_ikut_atk_buff_talent on CharacterTeamFinder (attribute 52 Electric DMG, formulaItem 5; duration 15 s; stackingType 2 max 1: a new grant replaces it, "cannot stack"). Values taken for the applier at application (her Intellect then).

triggers.note: COMBO TRIGGER: "When an enemy suffers Electrification" (anyone's, forced ones included: her ultimate's too). A trigger during the combo's 3 s cooldown opens nothing (batch-3 T5, engine-wide interim; in-game test 60).
"... or after an enemy's Electrification is consumed" (her battle skill's extra attack included).

extra_count buffEvent 6 at count = 3 (talent 1; literal: a stack threshold can't be a value): FinishBuffAdvanced all extra_count layers. The team buff itself comes from the completing extra hit, before its damage (hit extra).
P5 sets count = 2 (PotentialTalentEffectTable; literal: a stack threshold can't be a value).

hits.note: ChannelingAction from frame 5 every 0.033 s, at most 3 per target (display_atk_scale 3 × atk_scale).
Mask 2097280 (Final Strike); SP atb (17) and stagger poise (16) as the controlled operator only.
BreakingAttackCalculation multiplier 0.9; finisher SP is the engine's (GainBreakingAttackAtb).
Needs mid-air, so rotations don't cast it (S10); kept for calc.

skills.label: Battle skill: Tempestuous Arc
skills.note: Frame 0: IfElse CheckTagMatch 1466867135 (Electrification) on the target sets SpawnThird = 1; frame 4: JumpToAction → 96 if SpawnThird = 1 (the Electrification variant, judged on the enemy at the cast: batch-3 S7). Without it: slashes at 19 and 24, then the unconditional jump 95 → 204 (the frame-136 part never plays). With it: slashes at 112 and 118 (cast frames 20 and 26), then at 136 (cast 44) the extra attack if the target still has Electrification, else a third Physical slash. Team energy (buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp) at 24 on one path, 136 on the other (every frame-136 branch has it): exclusive, so both are 1 (batch-3 S6). Windows 36–60 and 162–188, exclusiveFrame 164: SkillData.

hits.label: Slash 1 (Electrification at the cast)
hits.note: After the frame-4 jump: cast frame 20.

hits.label: Additional attack (Electrification consumed)
hits.note: Frame 136, distance < 5 and CheckTagMatch Electrification on the smart target: CreateBuff extra_count (if talent_1 > 0), ObtainCostAction atb (atbSourceType 3: returned; P1 +10), DamageAction atk_scale2 damageType 3 (Electric) + poise2, then FinishBuffAdvanced tag 1466867135 (isFinishedEarly): the Electrification is consumed after the damage (afterDamage, batch-3 A4), so this hit keeps its Arts DMG Taken. The counter's layer comes first and its buffEvent 6 handler grants the team buff before the DamageAction (the buff's if is judged after the hit's gains: 3, or 2 at P5): interim, in-game test 65 (b).

hits.label: Third slash (Electrification gone by frame 136)
hits.note: The IfElse's false side: someone consumed the Electrification between the cast and frame 136 (not in the description).
Frame 17: ObtainCostAction atb (atbSourceType 3), DamageAction mask 12288 + poise, ObtainCostAction costType 0 usp.
display_atk_scale 3 × atk_scale: three slashes in all.

skills.label: Ultimate: Exploding Blitz
skills.note: SpawnAbilityEntity abilityentity_chr_0007_ikut_ultimate_skill at 54 (launch); its timeline chr_0007_ikut_ultimate_skill_abentity lands at its frames 7 and 63. Time stop 0–56, channel 0–85 (cantCastSkill, cantSwitchPosition), damage immunity: SkillData.

hits.note: Entity frame 7: SpellInfliction type 1 (Electric), then DamageAction atk_scale1 damageType 3 mask 4608 + poise1.

Entity frame 63: DamageAction atk_scale2 + poise2, then ForEach target with Electric Infliction (tag 2123008650): SaveBuffStackNumByTag count, ForceSpellStatusAction spellStatusType 1 (Electrification) with count = consumedLayer = the stacks, consumedType 1: the infliction is consumed and Electrification forced at that level, after the damage (batch-3 A3, A4). No Electric Infliction: level 0, nothing.
